label: L-05
title: UniswapHelper's hardcoded DOLA venue (Curve DOLA-3CRV) is near-empty: the DOLA route caps at ~$1.5k USDC out (-69% at 5k DOLA), and story 109 required a fork depth check for USDe but not DOLA
rootCause: Venue selection: CURVE_DOLA_3CRV holds ~1,889 DOLA / ~1,488 3CRV at block 26181407; story-109 depth-check gap let it ship.
description: The address and indices are correct (coins(0)=DOLA, 3pool coins(1)=USDC, so underlying index 2 = USDC). But at block 26181407 the pool holds only ~1,889 DOLA and ~1,488 3CRV. get_dy_underlying returns: 100 DOLA -> 99.62 USDC; 10,000 USDC -> 1,888.7 DOLA (-81%). Every DOLA leg crosses this pool with a 0 intermediate minimum. Only the caller's final minOut protects them. ECON-003 depth curve: DOLA->USDC 1,000->984.95 (-1.5%), 2,000->1,519 (-24%), 5,000->1,543 (-69%); USDC->DOLA 2,000->1,818 (-9%). Quote path uses the same pool, so quote-derived minOut protects users; the trap is a UI that shows output without price impact. Story 109 L168 asks for USDe depth only; L241 records a ~0.002% optimistic bias on USDC->DOLA (zero-tolerance minOut reverts, fail-closed).

attackPath: 3. Output collapses; protected only by caller's quote-derived minOut (I3 invariant PASS)
failureScenario.likelihood: high that the route is unusable at size; low for actual loss given quote-derived minOut
failureScenario.assumptions: Helper deployed with the current CURVE_DOLA_3CRV constant
failureScenario.externalRequirements: None for the function impairment (the route is unusable at size regardless of caller input). Note: a user or UI submitting a weak/zero minOut is user input (C4-invalid; cf. MR-008 in manual-review.json) and does NOT determine severity.

impact: The route on an immutable helper is unusable above ~$1.5k; only a redeploy fixes it; a quote-derived minOut prevents user loss. Advertised DOLA route delivers -24% at 2k and -69% at 5k DOLA->USDC; the helper is ownerless and the venue is a deploy-script constant. Any slippage leak goes to Curve LPs/arbitrageurs, never from protocol funds.
assetImpact: No protocol funds. Function impairment: DOLA route unusable above ~$1-1.5k (-24% at 2k, -69% at 5k DOLA->USDC) on an immutable helper; quote-derived minOut prevents user loss (I3 PASS).

tests: work/test/audit-run40/UniswapHelperInvariantsRun40.fork.t.sol (I3 invariant PASS: quote-derived minOut protected every DOLA call)

recommendation: Pick a deep DOLA venue before the story-111 broadcast (plan L186: DOLA/sUSDS Curve), or have the UI compute and block on price impact versus pair spot for every route.

classification.justification: Function impaired for an advertised route of a contract that is immutable once deployed (ownerless helper, venue from a deploy-script constant), so fixing it after broadcast means a redeploy. That is a non-obvious venue-choice footgun, to be fixed before story-111 broadcasts. Not Medium: the I3 invariant shows quote-derived minOut protects every DOLA call, and any leak goes to Curve LPs from the user's own slippage tolerance. Story 109 did not require a DOLA depth check, so this is a spec gap rather than a deviation, and no F label is assigned. Low.

storyFaithfulness.summary: No DOLA depth check in the story; spec gap.

sanitizerNote: KI 'External vault/yield strategy behavior (out of scope)' considered and rejected: the defect is a first-party hardcoded venue choice in DeployUniswapHelperMainnet.s.sol and a story-109 depth-check gap, not external protocol behaviour. No ledger match.
pocNote: Low/QA/F: no submission PoC required; fork evidence listed under evidence.
storyNote: Story 111 L39 itself names the CURVE_DOLA_3CRV venue, so the depth-check spec gap covers both story 109 and story 111.
reviewEdits: 2026-10-13 final review (validity VALID-WITH-EDITS): impact now leads with route unusability on an immutable helper; weak-minOut requirement marked as user input not determining severity; story 111 L39 venue note. Severity unchanged (Low).
